findings.summary: Traceability is requirement-level only; about eight MUST acceptance criteria have no observable test. Add an AC-to-test table or scenarios, or downgrade them explicitly.
Property tests use 200 runs with the 5 s default and no fileParallelism:false or 4x50 batching, the hazard the capsule suite already hit. Pre-plan batches with distinct seeds.
'Start a fresh copy' / rotateReplicaId has no requirement or test and is borderline scope. Add a SHOULD requirement plus unit test, or remove.
Ordering assertion compares against the app's own compareItems (circular). Compute the expected order independently from sortKey and item ID.
Requirement says 3 px outline; test asserts at least 2 px. Align.
Requirement says re-render from list() and listResults(); design says listResults() only. Align.
Accessibility/security row cites REQ-FL-015 wrongly (should be 016, 017, 008); REQ-FL-018 and 019 have no row.
Sub-path criterion under a MUST requirement is tested only by an optional scenario. Mark SHOULD or make the test required.
'Try again' is pressed inside expect.poll (a retry loop in spirit). Use a single click then a bounded wait on data-session.
Kit precedent for delete-vs-edit covers a new field, not an edit of an existing field. Verify at Kit level first; framed as a test already.
Appended entry has no trailing newline.
